name: Axe Compute Inc.
business_overview: Axe Compute Inc., provides access to graphics processing unit and digital asset treasury strategy. The company operates through two segments, Compute Services and Treasury Management and Drug Discovery Services segment. The Compute Services and Treasury Management segment includes access to GPU compute capacity and digital asset treasury strategy focused on ATH, the native utility token of the Aethir network. The Drug Discovery Services segment engages in the application of AI using its proprietary biobank of 150,000+ tumor samples, as well as creation of proprietary 3D culture models used in drug development. The company was formerly known as Predictive Oncology Inc. and changed its name to Axe Compute Inc. in December 2025. Axe Compute Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides GPU compute access and digital asset treasury services, as well as AI-driven drug discovery using a proprietary biobank.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Axe Compute has completed a strategic pivot from legacy drug discovery to an AI compute marketplace, and early commercial traction is now visible. The company serves a diverse base of over 20 enterprise customers and AI-native startups, with multiple active deployments. Demand signals are strong as the market increasingly values distributed GPU capacity, and the company’s value proposition emphasizes choice, speed, and broad distribution to enterprises building AI infrastructure.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership executed a rapid reinvention, rebranding the company and raising a war chest through a blend of cash and digital asset treasury tokens to fund an asset-light growth model. The team bolstered governance by adding semiconductor and telecommunications veterans to the board, and it is converting signed agreements into recurring revenue. The adoption of a strategic compute reserve and a digital asset strategy signals a forward-leaning, credibility-building approach that has captured retail and institutional attention.

# AGPU’s $343.5M Transformation: GPU Network Rollout and Digital Asset Strategy Propel New Era

## Strategic Overhaul: AGPU Shifts to AI Compute Infrastructure and Digital Asset Treasury

Axe Compute Inc. (NASDAQ: AGPU) just revealed its full-year 2025 results, spotlighting a year of profound reinvention. The company finished its foundational year announcing a complete pivot: from legacy drug discovery to a marketplace provider of on-demand GPU compute for artificial intelligence, funded in part by an aggressive $343.5 million capital raise. This bold transition also included the adoption of a digital asset treasury focused on the ATH token, underpinning the company’s Strategic Compute Reserve.
